stimulus.source_note: Paraphrase of the Treaty of Tordesillas (1494); the 370-league line west of the Cape Verde islands is the treaty's term.
stimulus.text: The 1494 agreement, brokered with the pope's approval, divided all newly discovered lands between the two Iberian crowns along a meridian 370 leagues west of the Cape Verde islands.

stem: The Treaty of Tordesillas was brokered with the pope's approval, and both Spain and Portugal accepted the division. What does their acceptance of papal mediation show about the Spanish and Portuguese crowns in the 1490s?

options.text: Both crowns believed the pope owned all newly discovered lands and could give them away at will
Both crowns still recognized the pope as an authority who could settle disputes between Catholic rulers
Both crowns had already broken with Rome and sought a neutral judge outside the Church
Both crowns accepted the treaty only because the pope threatened excommunication against whichever side refused it

instruction: Pick one option from the stimulus and stem only. Do not open the question file.
